_meta.description: Catalog of every dataset the platform and its CLIMADA runs use or hold. One entry per dataset; the id is a snake_case Python identifier and is the variable name used to load it (climaterisk.data.catalog.dataset(id), dataset_path(id)).
_meta.rule: Every value comes from repo code, docs, manifests or on-disk listings; anything not verifiable is the string 'unknown'. Dataset strings used in code (method_registry.json dataset, hazard_dataset, dataset_family) must be ids here (tests/test_dataset_catalog.py). Never open or hash data files to check presence (on_disk uses exists/listing only).
_meta.path_roots: path is relative to the data root (paths.data_root()), or prefixed repo: (repo root) or climada: (paths.climada_data_dir()). A glob in path is allowed; dataset_path returns the directory before the first glob component.
_meta.peril_tags: registry tags RF PF CF TC HW HM, or peril names (drought, wildfire, earthquake, heatwave); [] for exposure/boundary/terrain
_meta.data_sources_registry: assets/libraries/data_sources.json is the fetch registry; data_sources_id links to it
